ideal.content:
manifest: bbm92_system
system: bbm92_co_simulation_system
schema_version: '1.1'
imports:
- 01_protocol.yaml
- 02_source_central.yaml
- 03_alice_node.yaml
- 04_bob_node.yaml
- 05_channels.yaml
- 06_digital.yaml
- 07_post_processing.yaml
- 08_cosim.yaml
composition:
  nodes:
  - central_entanglement_source
  - alice_measurement_station
  - bob_measurement_station
validation:
  require_unique_instance_names: true
  require_declared_ports: true
  require_declared_clock_domains: false
  require_declared_packet_types: true
  require_bit_mapping_consistency: true

protocol:
  name: BBM92
  family: DV-EB
  encoding: DV
  bit_mapping:
    H: 0
    V: 1
    D: 0
    A: 1
  basis_selection: passive
  coincidence:
    window_ps: 1000
    multi_click_policy: discard
    require_one_click_per_side: true
  packet_types:
  - basis_announce
  - coincidence_report
  - ec_metadata
  - pa_metadata

subsystem: central_entanglement_source
role: entanglement_source
instances:
- name: central_pump_laser
  component: laser_source
  domain: optical
  role: pump_laser
  settings:
    center_wavelength: 775
    optical_pulse_repetition_rate: 100000000
    source_power: 0.01
  ports:
    pump_out: pump_out
    trigger_in: trigger_in
  annotations:
    pulse_width: 50 ps
    trigger_mode: external (driven by alice_ctrl_det.source_trigger)
- name: central_spdc_source
  component: entangled_photon_source
  domain: optical
  role: entangled_pair_source
  settings:
    entanglement_fidelity: 97
    output_wavelength: 1550
    pair_generation_rate: 1
    pump_wavelength: 775
  ports:
    pump_in: pump_in
    pair_a: pair_a
    pair_b: pair_b
  annotations:
    bell_state: Φ+ (phi_plus)
    intrinsic_visibility: 0.97 — mapped onto entanglement_fidelity for schema fit
    multi_pair_model: poisson
    pair_generation_probability_per_pulse: 0.01 per pulse (× 100 MHz rep rate = 1 Mio pairs/s)
- name: central_spdc_source.crystal
  component: spdc_nonlinear_crystal
  domain: optical
  role: spdc_crystal
  settings:
    idler_wavelength: 1550
    material: BBO
    phase_matching_type: type-II
    pump_wavelength: 775
    signal_wavelength: 1550
- name: src_comp_hwp_alice
  component: half_wave_plate
  domain: optical
  role: pair_a_hwp
  branch_side: alice
  settings:
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    retardance: 0.5
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    angle_deg: '0.0'
- name: src_comp_bbo_alice
  component: compensation_crystal
  domain: optical
  role: pair_a_birefringence_compensation
  branch_side: alice
  settings:
    material: BBO
    operating_wavelength: 1550
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    relative_thickness: 0.5 (unitless, per manifest)
- name: src_pol_ctrl_alice
  component: polarization_controller
  domain: optical
  role: pair_a_polarization_set
  branch_side: alice
  settings:
    mode: programmable
  ports:
    in: in
    quantum_to_alice: quantum_to_alice
    setpoint: setpoint
  annotations:
    initial_state: identity
    setpoint_source: driven by alice_ctrl_det.src_pol_set_a
- name: src_comp_hwp_bob
  component: half_wave_plate
  domain: optical
  role: pair_b_hwp
  branch_side: bob
  settings:
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    retardance: 0.5
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    angle_deg: '0.0'
- name: src_comp_bbo_bob
  component: compensation_crystal
  domain: optical
  role: pair_b_birefringence_compensation
  branch_side: bob
  settings:
    material: BBO
    operating_wavelength: 1550
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    relative_thickness: 0.5 (unitless, per manifest)
- name: src_pol_ctrl_bob
  component: polarization_controller
  domain: optical
  role: pair_b_polarization_set
  branch_side: bob
  settings:
    mode: programmable
  ports:
    in: in
    quantum_to_bob: quantum_to_bob
    setpoint: setpoint
  annotations:
    initial_state: identity
    setpoint_source: driven by alice_ctrl_det.src_pol_set_b
connections:
  optical:
  - from: central_pump_laser.pump_out
    to: central_spdc_source.pump_in
    label: Pump laser → SPDC source
  - from: central_spdc_source.pair_a
    to: src_comp_hwp_alice.in
    label: SPDC source → pair_a HWP
  - from: src_comp_hwp_alice.out
    to: src_comp_bbo_alice.in
    label: Pair_a HWP → compensation crystal
  - from: src_comp_bbo_alice.out
    to: src_pol_ctrl_alice.in
    label: Pair_a compensation crystal → polarization controller
  - from: central_spdc_source.pair_b
    to: src_comp_hwp_bob.in
    label: SPDC source → pair_b HWP
  - from: src_comp_hwp_bob.out
    to: src_comp_bbo_bob.in
    label: Pair_b HWP → compensation crystal
  - from: src_comp_bbo_bob.out
    to: src_pol_ctrl_bob.in
    label: Pair_b compensation crystal → polarization controller

subsystem: alice_measurement_station
role: measurement_station
instances:
- name: alice_basis_bs
  component: beam_splitter
  domain: optical
  role: passive_basis_choice
  settings:
    insertion_loss: 0.2
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    splitting_ratio: '50:50'
  ports:
    in: in
    out_z: out_z
    out_x: out_x
  annotations:
    imbalance_tolerance: '0.01'
    upstream_input_coupler_loss: 'alice_input_coupler insertion_loss_db: 0.3 (no dedicated catalog component type — folded in here)'
- name: alice_z_pbs
  component: polarisation_component
  domain: optical
  role: z_basis_analyzer
  branch_side: Z
  settings:
    extinction_ratio: 25
    insertion_loss: 0.2
    operating_wavelength: 1550
  ports:
    in: in
    out_h: out_h
    out_v: out_v
  annotations:
    polarization_leakage_prob: '0.003'
- name: alice_x_hwp
  component: half_wave_plate
  domain: optical
  role: x_basis_rotation
  branch_side: X
  settings:
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    retardance: 0.5
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    angle_deg: '22.5'
    angle_error_deg_sigma: '0.1'
- name: alice_x_pbs
  component: polarisation_component
  domain: optical
  role: x_basis_analyzer
  branch_side: X
  settings:
    extinction_ratio: 25
    insertion_loss: 0.2
    operating_wavelength: 1550
  ports:
    in: in
    out_d: out_d
    out_a: out_a
  annotations:
    polarization_leakage_prob: '0.003'
- name: alice_apd_h
  component: single_photon_detector
  domain: optical
  role: detector_z_h
  branch_side: H
  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.01
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.8
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11
    detector_variant: APD (free-running)
  ports:
    photon_in: photon_in
    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=Z, state=H, bit=0, channel_id=0
    eff_mismatch_delta: '0'
- name: alice_apd_v
  component: single_photon_detector
  domain: optical
  role: detector_z_v
  branch_side: V
  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.01
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.79
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11
    detector_variant: APD (free-running)
  ports:
    photon_in: photon_in
    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=Z, state=V, bit=1, channel_id=1
    eff_mismatch_delta: '-0.01'
- name: alice_apd_d
  component: single_photon_detector
  domain: optical
  role: detector_x_d
  branch_side: D
  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.011
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.81
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11
    detector_variant: APD (free-running)
  ports:
    photon_in: photon_in
    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=X, state=D, bit=0, channel_id=2
    eff_mismatch_delta: '0.01'
- name: alice_apd_a
  component: single_photon_detector
  domain: optical
  role: detector_x_a
  branch_side: A
  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.011
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.8
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11
    detector_variant: APD (free-running)
  ports:
    photon_in: photon_in
    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=X, state=A, bit=1, channel_id=3
    eff_mismatch_delta: '0'
connections:
  optical:
  - from: src_pol_ctrl_alice.quantum_to_alice
    to: quantum_to_alice.in
    label: Quantum channel to Alice (2 km fiber)
  - from: quantum_to_alice.out
    to: alice_basis_bs.in
    label: Quantum channel to Alice (2 km fiber)
  - from: alice_basis_bs.out_z
    to: alice_z_pbs.in
    label: Basis BS → Z-PBS
  - from: alice_z_pbs.out_h
    to: alice_apd_h.photon_in
    label: Z-PBS → APD_H
  - from: alice_z_pbs.out_v
    to: alice_apd_v.photon_in
    label: Z-PBS → APD_V
  - from: alice_basis_bs.out_x
    to: alice_x_hwp.in
    label: Basis BS → X-HWP (22.5°)
  - from: alice_x_hwp.out
    to: alice_x_pbs.in
    label: X-HWP → X-PBS
  - from: alice_x_pbs.out_d
    to: alice_apd_d.photon_in
    label: X-PBS → APD_D
  - from: alice_x_pbs.out_a
    to: alice_apd_a.photon_in
    label: X-PBS → APD_A

  ports:

  - from: src_pol_ctrl_bob.quantum_to_bob
    to: quantum_to_bob.in
    label: Quantum channel to Bob (2 km fiber)
  - from: quantum_to_bob.out
    to: bob_basis_bs.in
    label: Quantum channel to Bob (2 km fiber)
  - from: bob_basis_bs.out_z
    to: bob_z_pbs.in

  - from: bob_z_pbs.out_h

channels:
- name: quantum_to_alice
  type: quantum
  medium: single-mode fibre
  from: src_pol_ctrl_alice.quantum_to_alice
  to: alice_basis_bs.in
- name: quantum_to_bob
  type: quantum
  medium: single-mode fibre
  from: src_pol_ctrl_bob.quantum_to_bob
  to: bob_basis_bs.in
- name: qkd_classical_link
  type: classical
  medium: ethernet_or_serial
  from: alice_qkd_comms.comms_out
  to: bob_ctrl_det.comms_in
- name: time_sync_link
  type: sync
  medium: electrical_or_optical_sync
  from: alice_time_sync.sync_out
  to: bob_time_sync.sync_in

subsystem: digital
instances:
- name: alice_tdc
  component: time_digital_converter
  domain: digital
  role: click_timestamping
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_tdc
  settings:
    number_of_channels: 4
  ports:
    click_in[0]: click_in[0]
    click_in[1]: click_in[1]
    click_in[2]: click_in[2]
    click_in[3]: click_in[3]
    event_out: event_out
  annotations:
    counter_width_bits: '64'
    fine_time_enable: 'true'
- name: alice_ctrl_det
  component: fpga_system_controller_tx
  domain: digital
  role: protocol_controller
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_ctrl_det
  ports:
    source_trigger: source_trigger
    src_pol_set_a: src_pol_set_a
    src_pol_set_b: src_pol_set_b
  annotations:
    protocol_stack: 'qkd_control_detection — master source controller: drives central_pump_laser.trigger_in AND sets polarization setpoints on both src_pol_ctrl_alice and src_pol_ctrl_bob (controls the shared entanglement source, not just Alice''s own station)'
- name: alice_qkd_comms
  component: fpga_system_controller_tx
  domain: digital
  role: classical_comms_core
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_qkd_comms
  ports:
    comms_out: comms_out
  annotations:
    protocol_stack: qkd_comms_core — carries basis_announce / coincidence_report / ec_metadata / pa_metadata packet exchange with Bob over qkd_classical_link
- name: alice_time_sync
  component: clock_synthesizer_tx
  domain: digital
  role: time_sync_master
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_time_sync
  settings:
    synchronization_mode: internal
    timing_jitter: 3.0e-11
  ports:
    sync_out: sync_out
  annotations:
    clock_domains: 'sys_clk: 125 MHz, tdc_clk: 1 GHz, comms_clk: 156.25 MHz'
    time_sync_link_latency: 100 ns
- name: bob_tdc
  component: time_digital_converter
  domain: digital
  role: click_timestamping
  implementation: verilog
  module: bob_tdc
  settings:
    number_of_channels: 4
  ports:
    click_in[0]: click_in[0]
    click_in[1]: click_in[1]
    click_in[2]: click_in[2]
    click_in[3]: click_in[3]
    event_out: event_out
  annotations:
    counter_width_bits: '64'
    fine_time_enable: 'true'
- name: coincidence_matcher
  component: coincidence_matcher
  domain: digital
  role: sifting_coincidence_logic
  implementation: verilog
  module: coincidence_matcher
  settings:
    coincidence_window: 1.0e-09
    number_of_channels: 2
  ports:
    alice_event_in: alice_event_in
    bob_event_in: bob_event_in
  annotations:
    multi_click_policy: 1 (discard)
    timestamp_width_bits: '64'
- name: bob_ctrl_det
  component: fpga_system_controller_rx
  domain: digital
  role: protocol_controller
  implementation: verilog
  module: bob_ctrl_det
  ports:
    comms_in: comms_in
  annotations:
    protocol_stack: 'qkd_control_detection (Bob side); also hosts qkd_comms_core function (bob_qkd_comms) — carries basis_announce / coincidence_report / ec_metadata / pa_metadata packet exchange with Alice over qkd_classical_link. Merged here: no second FPGA/Controller (RX) catalog row exists to represent them separately.'
- name: bob_time_sync
  component: clock_synthesizer_rx
  domain: digital
  role: time_sync_slave
  implementation: verilog
  module: bob_time_sync
  settings:
    synchronization_mode: external-reference-lock
    timing_jitter: 3.0e-11
  ports:
    sync_in: sync_in
  annotations:
    clock_domains: 'sys_clk: 125 MHz, tdc_clk: 1 GHz, comms_clk: 156.25 MHz'
    time_sync_link_latency: 100 ns

post_processing:
- stage: Public Announcements
  config: basis_announce packets (epoch_id, event_id, basis, valid) exchanged over qkd_classical_link — bit values never revealed, only basis
- stage: Sifting
  config: Nearest-timestamp coincidence matching (1000 ps window, one click per side required, multi-click discarded) via coincidence_matcher; keep same-basis events only
- stage: Parameter Estimation
  config: QBER estimated from 10% sample fraction of X-basis (parameter-estimation) events; Z basis reserved as key basis
- stage: Error Correction
  config: 'LDPC, code_rate: 0.85, block_size_bits: 65536, max_iterations: 50, leakage_accounting: true'
- stage: Error Verification
  config: 'Authenticated via universal hash MAC, tag_bits: 128 (ε_correct = 1×10⁻¹²)'
- stage: Privacy Amplification
  config: 'Toeplitz hash, block_size_bits: 65536, seed_source: authenticated classical channel, finite_key_mode: true (ε_secret = 1×10⁻¹²)'

co_simulation:
  mode: event_driven
  reset: sync_reset_active_high
  verilog_sources:
  - alice_tdc.v
  - alice_ctrl_det.v
  - alice_qkd_comms.v
  - alice_time_sync.v
  - bob_tdc.v
  - coincidence_matcher.v
  - bob_ctrl_det.v
  - bob_time_sync.v
  bindings:
  - from: alice_apd_h.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[0]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_H click → TDC
  - from: alice_apd_v.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[1]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_V click → TDC
  - from: alice_apd_d.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[2]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_D click → TDC
  - from: alice_apd_a.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[3]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_A click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_h.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[0]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_H click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_v.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[1]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_V click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_d.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[2]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_D click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_a.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[3]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_A click → TDC
  - from: alice_tdc.event_out
    to: coincidence_matcher.alice_event_in
    type: event_bridge
    medium: digital bus
    label: Alice TDC timestamps → coincidence matcher
  - from: bob_tdc.event_out
    to: coincidence_matcher.bob_event_in
    type: event_bridge
    medium: digital bus
    label: Bob TDC timestamps → coincidence matcher
  - from: alice_ctrl_det.source_trigger
    to: central_pump_laser.trigger_in
    type: control_bridge
    medium: digital control (trigger)
    label: alice_ctrl_det.source_trigger → central_pump_laser.trigger_in
  - from: alice_ctrl_det.src_pol_set_a
    to: src_pol_ctrl_alice.setpoint
    type: control_bridge
    medium: digital bus

characterised.content:
manifest: bbm92_system
system: bbm92_co_simulation_system
schema_version: '1.1'
imports:
- 01_protocol.yaml
- 02_source_central.yaml
- 03_alice_node.yaml
- 04_bob_node.yaml
- 05_channels.yaml
- 06_digital.yaml
- 07_post_processing.yaml
- 08_cosim.yaml
composition:
  nodes:
  - central_entanglement_source
  - alice_measurement_station
  - bob_measurement_station
validation:
  require_unique_instance_names: true
  require_declared_ports: true
  require_declared_clock_domains: false
  require_declared_packet_types: true
  require_bit_mapping_consistency: true

protocol:
  name: BBM92
  family: DV-EB
  encoding: DV
  bit_mapping:
    H: 0
    V: 1
    D: 0
    A: 1
  basis_selection: passive
  coincidence:
    window_ps: 1000
    multi_click_policy: discard
    require_one_click_per_side: true
  packet_types:
  - basis_announce
  - coincidence_report
  - ec_metadata
  - pa_metadata

subsystem: central_entanglement_source
role: entanglement_source
instances:
- name: central_pump_laser
  component: laser_source
  domain: optical
  role: pump_laser
  settings:
    center_wavelength: 775
    optical_pulse_repetition_rate: 100000000
    source_power: 0.01
  ports:
    pump_out: pump_out
    trigger_in: trigger_in
  annotations:
    pulse_width: 50 ps
    trigger_mode: external (driven by alice_ctrl_det.source_trigger)
- name: central_spdc_source
  component: entangled_photon_source
  domain: optical
  role: entangled_pair_source
  settings:
    entanglement_fidelity: 97
    output_wavelength: 1550
    pair_generation_rate: 1
    pump_wavelength: 775
  ports:
    pump_in: pump_in
    pair_a: pair_a
    pair_b: pair_b
  annotations:
    bell_state: Φ+ (phi_plus)
    intrinsic_visibility: 0.97 — mapped onto entanglement_fidelity for schema fit
    multi_pair_model: poisson
    pair_generation_probability_per_pulse: 0.01 per pulse (× 100 MHz rep rate = 1 Mio pairs/s)
- name: central_spdc_source.crystal
  component: spdc_nonlinear_crystal
  domain: optical
  role: spdc_crystal
  settings:
    idler_wavelength: 1550
    material: BBO
    phase_matching_type: type-II
    pump_wavelength: 775
    signal_wavelength: 1550
- name: src_comp_hwp_alice
  component: half_wave_plate
  domain: optical
  role: pair_a_hwp
  branch_side: alice
  settings:
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    retardance: 0.5
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    angle_deg: '0.0'
- name: src_comp_bbo_alice
  component: compensation_crystal
  domain: optical
  role: pair_a_birefringence_compensation
  branch_side: alice
  settings:
    material: BBO
    operating_wavelength: 1550
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    relative_thickness: 0.5 (unitless, per manifest)
- name: src_pol_ctrl_alice
  component: polarization_controller
  domain: optical
  role: pair_a_polarization_set
  branch_side: alice
  settings:
    mode: programmable
  ports:
    in: in
    quantum_to_alice: quantum_to_alice
    setpoint: setpoint
  annotations:
    initial_state: identity
    setpoint_source: driven by alice_ctrl_det.src_pol_set_a
- name: src_comp_hwp_bob
  component: half_wave_plate
  domain: optical
  role: pair_b_hwp
  branch_side: bob
  settings:
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    retardance: 0.5
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    angle_deg: '0.0'
- name: src_comp_bbo_bob
  component: compensation_crystal
  domain: optical
  role: pair_b_birefringence_compensation
  branch_side: bob
  settings:
    material: BBO
    operating_wavelength: 1550
  ports:
    in: in
    out: out
  annotations:
    relative_thickness: 0.5 (unitless, per manifest)
- name: src_pol_ctrl_bob
  component: polarization_controller
  domain: optical
  role: pair_b_polarization_set
  branch_side: bob
  settings:
    mode: programmable
  ports:
    in: in
    quantum_to_bob: quantum_to_bob
    setpoint: setpoint
  annotations:
    initial_state: identity
    setpoint_source: driven by alice_ctrl_det.src_pol_set_b
connections:
  optical:
  - from: central_pump_laser.pump_out
    to: central_spdc_source.pump_in
    label: Pump laser → SPDC source
  - from: central_spdc_source.pair_a
    to: src_comp_hwp_alice.in
    label: SPDC source → pair_a HWP
  - from: src_comp_hwp_alice.out
    to: src_comp_bbo_alice.in
    label: Pair_a HWP → compensation crystal
  - from: src_comp_bbo_alice.out
    to: src_pol_ctrl_alice.in
    label: Pair_a compensation crystal → polarization controller
  - from: central_spdc_source.pair_b
    to: src_comp_hwp_bob.in
    label: SPDC source → pair_b HWP
  - from: src_comp_hwp_bob.out
    to: src_comp_bbo_bob.in
    label: Pair_b HWP → compensation crystal
  - from: src_comp_bbo_bob.out
    to: src_pol_ctrl_bob.in
    label: Pair_b compensation crystal → polarization controller

subsystem: alice_measurement_station
role: measurement_station
instances:
- name: alice_basis_bs
  component: beam_splitter

  role: passive_basis_choice
  settings:
    insertion_loss: 0.2

- name: alice_apd_v

  domain: optical
  role: detector_z_v

  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.01
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.79
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11

    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=Z, state=V, bit=1, channel_id=1
    eff_mismatch_delta: '-0.01'
- name: alice_apd_d
  component: single_photon_detector
  domain: optical
  role: detector_x_d
  branch_side: D
  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.011
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.81
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11
    detector_variant: APD (free-running)
  ports:
    photon_in: photon_in
    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=X, state=D, bit=0, channel_id=2
    eff_mismatch_delta: '0.01'
- name: alice_apd_a

  domain: optical

  settings:
    afterpulse_probability: 0.011
    dark_count_rate: 100
    dead_time: 5.0e-08
    detection_efficiency: 0.8
    operating_wavelength: 1550
    timing_jitter: 5.0e-11
    detector_variant: APD (free-running)
  ports:
    photon_in: photon_in
    click: click
  annotations:
    detector_role: basis=X, state=A, bit=1, channel_id=3
    eff_mismatch_delta: '0'
connections:
  optical:
  - from: src_pol_ctrl_alice.quantum_to_alice
    to: quantum_to_alice.in
    label: Quantum channel to Alice (2 km fiber)
  - from: quantum_to_alice.out
    to: alice_basis_bs.in
    label: Quantum channel to Alice (2 km fiber)
  - from: alice_basis_bs.out_z
    to: alice_z_pbs.in
    label: Basis BS → Z-PBS
  - from: alice_z_pbs.out_h
    to: alice_apd_h.photon_in
    label: Z-PBS → APD_H
  - from: alice_z_pbs.out_v
    to: alice_apd_v.photon_in
    label: Z-PBS → APD_V
  - from: alice_basis_bs.out_x
    to: alice_x_hwp.in
    label: Basis BS → X-HWP (22.5°)
  - from: alice_x_hwp.out
    to: alice_x_pbs.in
    label: X-HWP → X-PBS
  - from: alice_x_pbs.out_d
    to: alice_apd_d.photon_in
    label: X-PBS → APD_D
  - from: alice_x_pbs.out_a
    to: alice_apd_a.photon_in

channels:
- name: quantum_to_alice
  type: quantum
  medium: single-mode fibre
  from: src_pol_ctrl_alice.quantum_to_alice
  to: alice_basis_bs.in
- name: quantum_to_bob
  type: quantum
  medium: single-mode fibre
  from: src_pol_ctrl_bob.quantum_to_bob
  to: bob_basis_bs.in
- name: qkd_classical_link
  type: classical
  medium: ethernet_or_serial
  from: alice_qkd_comms.comms_out
  to: bob_ctrl_det.comms_in
- name: time_sync_link
  type: sync
  medium: electrical_or_optical_sync
  from: alice_time_sync.sync_out
  to: bob_time_sync.sync_in

subsystem: digital
instances:
- name: alice_tdc
  component: time_digital_converter
  domain: digital
  role: click_timestamping
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_tdc
  settings:
    number_of_channels: 4
  ports:
    click_in[0]: click_in[0]
    click_in[1]: click_in[1]
    click_in[2]: click_in[2]
    click_in[3]: click_in[3]
    event_out: event_out
  annotations:
    counter_width_bits: '64'
    fine_time_enable: 'true'
- name: alice_ctrl_det
  component: fpga_system_controller_tx
  domain: digital
  role: protocol_controller
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_ctrl_det
  ports:
    source_trigger: source_trigger
    src_pol_set_a: src_pol_set_a
    src_pol_set_b: src_pol_set_b
  annotations:
    protocol_stack: 'qkd_control_detection — master source controller: drives central_pump_laser.trigger_in AND sets polarization setpoints on both src_pol_ctrl_alice and src_pol_ctrl_bob (controls the shared entanglement source, not just Alice''s own station)'
- name: alice_qkd_comms
  component: fpga_system_controller_tx
  domain: digital
  role: classical_comms_core
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_qkd_comms
  ports:
    comms_out: comms_out
  annotations:
    protocol_stack: qkd_comms_core — carries basis_announce / coincidence_report / ec_metadata / pa_metadata packet exchange with Bob over qkd_classical_link
- name: alice_time_sync
  component: clock_synthesizer_tx
  domain: digital
  role: time_sync_master
  implementation: verilog
  module: alice_time_sync
  settings:
    synchronization_mode: internal
    timing_jitter: 3.0e-11
  ports:
    sync_out: sync_out
  annotations:
    clock_domains: 'sys_clk: 125 MHz, tdc_clk: 1 GHz, comms_clk: 156.25 MHz'
    time_sync_link_latency: 100 ns
- name: bob_tdc
  component: time_digital_converter
  domain: digital
  role: click_timestamping
  implementation: verilog
  module: bob_tdc
  settings:
    number_of_channels: 4
  ports:
    click_in[0]: click_in[0]
    click_in[1]: click_in[1]
    click_in[2]: click_in[2]
    click_in[3]: click_in[3]
    event_out: event_out
  annotations:
    counter_width_bits: '64'
    fine_time_enable: 'true'
- name: coincidence_matcher
  component: coincidence_matcher
  domain: digital
  role: sifting_coincidence_logic
  implementation: verilog
  module: coincidence_matcher
  settings:
    coincidence_window: 1.0e-09
    number_of_channels: 2
  ports:
    alice_event_in: alice_event_in
    bob_event_in: bob_event_in
  annotations:
    multi_click_policy: 1 (discard)
    timestamp_width_bits: '64'
- name: bob_ctrl_det
  component: fpga_system_controller_rx
  domain: digital
  role: protocol_controller
  implementation: verilog
  module: bob_ctrl_det
  ports:
    comms_in: comms_in
  annotations:
    protocol_stack: 'qkd_control_detection (Bob side); also hosts qkd_comms_core function (bob_qkd_comms) — carries basis_announce / coincidence_report / ec_metadata / pa_metadata packet exchange with Alice over qkd_classical_link. Merged here: no second FPGA/Controller (RX) catalog row exists to represent them separately.'
- name: bob_time_sync
  component: clock_synthesizer_rx
  domain: digital
  role: time_sync_slave
  implementation: verilog
  module: bob_time_sync
  settings:
    synchronization_mode: external-reference-lock
    timing_jitter: 3.0e-11
  ports:
    sync_in: sync_in
  annotations:
    clock_domains: 'sys_clk: 125 MHz, tdc_clk: 1 GHz, comms_clk: 156.25 MHz'
    time_sync_link_latency: 100 ns

post_processing:
- stage: Public Announcements
  config: basis_announce packets (epoch_id, event_id, basis, valid) exchanged over qkd_classical_link — bit values never revealed, only basis
- stage: Sifting
  config: Nearest-timestamp coincidence matching (1000 ps window, one click per side required, multi-click discarded) via coincidence_matcher; keep same-basis events only
- stage: Parameter Estimation
  config: QBER estimated from 10% sample fraction of X-basis (parameter-estimation) events; Z basis reserved as key basis
- stage: Error Correction
  config: 'LDPC, code_rate: 0.85, block_size_bits: 65536, max_iterations: 50, leakage_accounting: true'
- stage: Error Verification
  config: 'Authenticated via universal hash MAC, tag_bits: 128 (ε_correct = 1×10⁻¹²)'
- stage: Privacy Amplification
  config: 'Toeplitz hash, block_size_bits: 65536, seed_source: authenticated classical channel, finite_key_mode: true (ε_secret = 1×10⁻¹²)'

co_simulation:
  mode: event_driven
  reset: sync_reset_active_high
  verilog_sources:
  - alice_tdc.v
  - alice_ctrl_det.v
  - alice_qkd_comms.v
  - alice_time_sync.v
  - bob_tdc.v
  - coincidence_matcher.v
  - bob_ctrl_det.v
  - bob_time_sync.v
  bindings:
  - from: alice_apd_h.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[0]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_H click → TDC
  - from: alice_apd_v.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[1]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_V click → TDC
  - from: alice_apd_d.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[2]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_D click → TDC
  - from: alice_apd_a.click
    to: alice_tdc.click_in[3]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Alice APD_A click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_h.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[0]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_H click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_v.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[1]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_V click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_d.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[2]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_D click → TDC
  - from: bob_apd_a.click
    to: bob_tdc.click_in[3]
    type: event_bridge
    medium: coaxial (electrical)
    label: Bob APD_A click → TDC
  - from: alice_tdc.event_out
    to: coincidence_matcher.alice_event_in
    type: event_bridge
    medium: digital bus
    label: Alice TDC timestamps → coincidence matcher
  - from: bob_tdc.event_out
    to: coincidence_matcher.bob_event_in
    type: event_bridge
